set.body:
Personally execute the user's requested final check of the agent doing the bulk of implementation after lead-owned M0.02 and M0.03. Owner: scalafim-umvpa-foundation-lead. This is a source-and-execution audit with bounded corrective work, not another report assembled from implementer summaries.

Inputs: PRD v0.2, live epic bd-01M2BMGRP4MSM0RRRKNTHM0H4K, first-two-item provider/identity acceptance evidence, the actual integrated revision and provider closure, all delegated scenario/benchmark/calibration records. Begin after M3, M4, and M5.04/M5.05/M5.06 deliverables; precede the existing M5.07 release-evidence gate to avoid a cycle.

Acceptance:
1. Map every delegated requirement and migration-ledger row to actual source, executable behavior and artifacts. Inspect all three shared-core workflows and extension rehearsal; no facade over retired engines, shadow provider math or parallel result/lifecycle hierarchy.
2. Independently reproduce adversarial axis/reindexing/duplicate-draw, metric/origin, own-target-free preparation, holdout exposure, Haufe/rotation/ROI conditioning, null/rank/group and retry/resource cases appropriate to claimed support. Closed motes and aggregate green test counts are not proof.
3. Run affected JVM and Scala.js checks in bounded sbt batches on the actual integrated code. Separate semantic, numerical, scope, resource and scientific evidence; keep experimental/unsupported claims visible.
4. Record actionable findings with severity, exact source/revision, reproduction, affected claim and owning packet. Personally fix bounded integration defects within this epic and rerun independent checks; return larger defects to their owners with blocking regression tickets. Preserve unrelated concurrent edits; no silent scope reduction to make tests pass.
5. Produce docs/audits/unified-mvpa-final-implementation-review.md with verified coverage and unresolved findings. Close only when required defects are resolved or an explicit user-approved scope amendment exists. No Git push/release publication is implied.

M0.07, M4.09 and M5.04 retain independent review of the lead's early work and scientific claims. This lead audit does not replace those independent qualification gates. M5.07 consumes this audit and assembles final release evidence; it is not duplicated here. The audit cannot be completed before the delegated implementation exists.
set.title: UMVPA-FINAL: Lead audit and remediation of the delegated implementation
